intro: A three-minute checkpoint on the first half of this module, in your own AI assistant with voice on: one short message said three ways. The tutor gives you a situation (a postponed meeting, a project that has stalled) and asks for it first as you would put it to a committee, then as you would tell a friend, then reported to a third person. It listens for four things: a formal register built from nouns, hedges and the fitting verb–noun collocation; a colloquial register built from modal particles, ellipsis and short clauses; a clean switch in which the whole sentence is rebuilt rather than one word swapped; and a report in the Konjunktiv I sustained over more than one clause. Speak in full sentences; type ‘Ende’ for the score.
tips[0].title: Formal: nouns, hedges and the fitting verb
tips[0].text: Pack the action into a noun (die Verschiebung des Termins), soften the claim (nach derzeitigem Stand, weitgehend, gewissermaßen) and give the noun its own verb (eine Entscheidung treffen, Maßnahmen ergreifen, Bedenken anmelden).
tips[0].check.why: In the formal register Bedenken takes its own verb: Bedenken anmelden.
tips[1].title: Colloquial: particles, ellipsis, short clauses
tips[1].text: Speech drops the subject or the article where the context carries it (Weiß ich nicht. Wird später.), adds modal particles (halt, eben, ja, mal) and strings short main clauses together instead of subordinating.
tips[1].check.why: The dropped subject and the particle halt mark spoken German; the other two are nominal and formal.
tips[2].title: Switch the whole sentence, never half
tips[2].text: When the tutor asks for the other register, rebuild the sentence: syntax, verb, nouns and particles move together. A nominal phrase inside a chatty clause, or halt inside an official sentence, is the mix a listener notices at once.
tips[2].trap: Die Umsetzung erfolgt halt zeitnah — a formal sentence with a colloquial particle is neither register.
tips[2].check.why: The other two mix a formal frame with spoken particles (halt, eben, weißt du), which is neither register.
tips[2].visual.rows[0].b: Das Vorhaben konnte leider nicht realisiert werden.
tips[3].title: Report and sustain the Konjunktiv I
tips[3].text: „Wir haben alles versucht. Die Lage ist ernst.“ → Er sagte, man habe alles versucht; die Lage sei ernst. One introducing verb, then Konjunktiv I in every clause that follows — do not slide back into the indicative.
tips[3].check.why: Once the report starts in the Konjunktiv I (sei), every following clause stays in it: man müsse.
remember[0]: Formal = noun + hedge + fitting verb; colloquial = particle + ellipsis + short clause.
remember[1]: Rebuild the whole sentence when you switch.
remember[2]: One introducing verb, then Konjunktiv I throughout.
hook: Say the same news three ways, to a committee, to a friend and reported, and keep each register clean from start to finish.
